about.label: Who I am
about.title: About
about.bio_1: I'm a FullStack Developer with a strong focus on the frontend. I care deeply about the intersection of engineering and design — building interfaces that are not only functional, but fast, accessible, and visually compelling.
about.bio_2: My main stack revolves around <accent>React</accent> and <accent>Next.js</accent> on the frontend, and <accent>FastAPI</accent> with <accent>Python</accent> on the backend. I enjoy working across the full stack — from API design and database modeling to animations and micro-interactions.
about.bio_3: When I'm not coding, I'm exploring UI/UX trends, contributing to side projects, or diving into anything related to web performance and developer experience.
